featured_reviews.name: Jignesh Desai
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an excellent experience at Alien Tattoo, Malad (Mumbai). A big shout-out to Gaurav and Ashima for the amazing work on my leg and arm tattoos. Their attention to detail, artistic skill, and patience really stood out, and the final result exceeded my expectations.

Special thanks to Jeet and Deepa for constantly checking in and making sure I was comfortable throughout the sessions—it truly felt very customer-centric. Also appreciate Vishal and Grishita for reviewing the final tattoo and ensuring everything met the required quality standards.

Overall, a very professional, well-managed studio with a strong focus on quality and customer experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking for top-notch tattoo work.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently got a tattoo done at Alien’s Tattoo, and I couldn’t be happier with my experience. From the moment I walked in, the staff made me feel comfortable and guided me through the process with complete professionalism. The studio itself is very clean, hygienic, and welcoming, which instantly gave me confidence.

My tattoo was done by artist Nevil, and I must say he is absolutely amazing. He patiently listened to my ideas, gave helpful suggestions, and ensured the design matched exactly what I had in mind. His attention to detail, precision, and creativity truly reflect his expertise. Throughout the process, he made sure I was comfortable and explained each step, which made the entire experience smooth and enjoyable.

The final result exceeded my expectations — the tattoo looks fantastic, with clean lines and perfect detailing. I’ve already received so many compliments on it! I would highly recommend Alien’s Tattoo to anyone who is planning to get inked, and a special mention to Nevil for his professionalism and outstanding artistry.

featured_reviews.name: Chetan Ningoo
featured_reviews.review_text: Absolutely loved my experience! Rajesh did an incredible job — very professional and precise. The ambience is superb, the staff is warm and welcoming, and the hygiene standards are top-notch. It’s not just a tattoo session, it’s an experience at Aliens. Would definitely recommend!

featured_reviews.name: Tejaswini Chaudhari
featured_reviews.review_text: I had an absolutely amazing experience at Aliens! Gaurav was instrumental in helping us nail down the design, and Arjun executed the tattoo to absolute perfection. The entire team is incredibly involved, supportive, and professional throughout the process. Special thanks to Siddhesh and all other artists for their inputs!! Whether you’re looking for something small or a massive piece, I would definitely recommend this spot to get inked.

featured_reviews.name: Rohit S. Shrikhande
featured_reviews.review_text:
I got my tattoo done here two days ago, and the entire journey was smooth and memorable. From the first call itself, JD from the Aliens team picked up and patiently guided me through the whole process. From consultation to booking the appointment, everything was handled seamlessly over the call.

On the tattoo day, the consultation was very comfortable and well explained. My artist was Rajesh, and for my friend it was Gaurav—both were extremely polite, humble, and genuinely creative. Since it was our first tattoo, they made sure we felt relaxed and confident throughout the process.

The tattoo was crafted very smoothly, and the experience turned into an unforgettable moment for us. Thank you to the entire team at Aliens Tattoo for such professionalism and warmth. Highly recommended! 🙌✨

featured_reviews.name: CA Viicky Tatkare
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of getting a tattoo at Aliens Tattoo Studio and the experience was nothing short of extraordinary.
I want to extend my special thanks to Ms. Sarvajeet, who handles client requirements with incredible efficiency. She has a remarkable ability to understand exactly what a client has in mind, helping to refine the design and ensure the perfect artist is allotted for the job.
In my case, she expertly matched my vision with Mr. Aman Vishwakarma, and it was the perfect choice.
I am deeply grateful to Mr. Aman for his exquisite work. His expertise in spiritual tattoos is truly evident; from the intricate details of the Trishula and Damru seen in the images to the perfect shading, his dedication to this special piece was amazing to witness.
The level of precision and artistic vision brought to the table exceeded all my expectations. Not only am I personally thrilled with the result, but my friends and family haven't stopped admiring the craftsmanship. I am already looking forward to many more tattoos in the future with them!

featured_reviews.name: Vivek Krishnan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently got my first tattoo at Sam Tattoos India, and it was an amazing experience from start to end. Was a little nervous just like anyone else who is getting their first tattoo done. I am extremely happy with how my tattoo turned out and couldn't have asked for a better first tattoo experience.

They had a welcoming atmosphere & Artist Mansi who attended & designed my tattoo made me feel comfortable and guided me through the entire process. She was patient, professional, incredibly talented and paid great attention to details.
Since I wasn’t sure about how I wanted the tattoo to look like, her skills to understand my interests and designing this beautiful piece of artwork was just amazing.
Special mention to Artist Ankit & Artist Hardik who doubled checked to ensure every detail & measurements was exactly right before starting.

Throughout the session, they made me feel comfortable and relaxed, explaining the process and checking in regularly.

The level of precision and attention to detail was outstanding, and the final result exceeded my expectations. The artwork is beautiful, the lines are crisp, and the overall quality is exceptional.

The entire SAM TATTOO team deserves commendation for their meticulous coordination and execution throughout.

What really stood out was the artists & teams’ passion for their work and dedication to making sure I was completely happy with the outcome. It's clear they genuinely care about their clients and take pride in every piece they create.

I would highly recommend SAM TATTOS India to anyone looking for a skilled artist, quality work & incredible results.

Thank you SAM TATTOO India for creating something I'll cherish forever.

featured_reviews.name: Ashok Choudhary
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing experience with tattoo artist Rohan Rana. He really took the time to understand every design element and meaning I wanted in my tattoo, and worked on it with incredible attention to detail. What I appreciated the most was his patience, creativity, and the way he guided me with honest suggestions to make the final design look even better than I imagined.

Rohan’s professionalism and passion for tattoo art truly reflect in his work. From placement to fine detailing, everything was done with precision and care, making the whole process smooth and comfortable.

Also, a big shoutout to the entire team — everyone was extremely friendly, attentive, and welcoming. The studio atmosphere is very comfortable and positive, and it genuinely felt like everyone wanted to give their best opinions and efforts to make the tattoo perfect.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality work, creativity, and a great overall tattoo experience.

featured_reviews.name: Parin Gajjar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Well, i wanted to get Armband & happened to visit Sam Tattoo. I found the studio quite spacious, neat & hygienic. The staff walked me through different options & designs. My artist Mr. Hardik was very patient enough to listen to my thoughts and helped me design my band. It was almost 4hrs session wherein his professional skills & experience played huge role to get my first tattoo done smoothly and easily. He made me feel very comfortable while explaining the process while embossing my tattoo..Thanks Hardik. You are the best.
Guys, I’d recommend all who want to get Tattoo must visit this Studio..!!

featured_reviews.name: Seth
featured_reviews.review_text: Exceptional work on my Lord Shiva forearm piece. The artist Vidhi translated my idea into a stunning black-and-gray portrait with beautiful flow down the arm. The face is soft and lifelike, the hair and snake details are packed with fine linework, and the Om symbol with the crescent moon sits perfectly as a halo. Down toward the wrist, the cosmic swirl adds a powerful, spiritual anchor to the whole design. Shading is smooth and the overall composition uses the forearm shape really well. If you want a detailed devotional portrait in Mumbai, this is the place. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Sathyanarayana Lakshminarayanan
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was my very first tattoo, and the entire experience was truly amazing—something I will always remember. From the moment I walked in, I could see the passion and dedication the team has for their work. They don’t even begin until they are completely satisfied with the design and placement, which shows how much they value perfection and client satisfaction.
What really impressed me was their commitment. They are willing to work long hours just to ensure the tattoo is completed perfectly, without compromising on quality. This level of dedication is rare and speaks volumes about their professionalism.
It turned out to be a wonderful surprise for my family, and the final result exceeded all expectations. Ridhi, the artist who worked on my tattoo, was incredibly patient and detailed. She took great care in every single element, especially with the fine detailing, and you can clearly see her expertise—particularly in portrait work. Her focus on perfection truly reflects in her art.
Overall, the entire team at Sam Tattoo feels like a family. They are not only highly professional but also deeply passionate about what they do. My first tattoo experience couldn’t have been better, and I’m genuinely grateful for their effort and artistry.

featured_reviews.name: jimmy shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
This marks my 3rd tattoo with Sam Tattoo & once again the experience has been nothing short of exceptional. I walked in with just an idea & the team transformed it into an artwork that exceeded all expectations.

A special shout-out to Bhavin whose patience and dedication truly stand out. This time he poured 18 hours of pure focus and craftsmanship into the piece ensuring every detail was perfected. That level of commitment is rare and deeply appreciated.

What makes Sam Tattoo feel like home is not just the talent but the culture every artist is welcoming supportive & genuinely celebrates each other’s work. That mutual respect and passion reflect clearly in the quality they deliver.

Grateful for another unforgettable experience and proud to wear this art for life.

featured_reviews.name: dr abhishek singh
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently got my shoulder and upper arm tattoo done by Saiyam at Sam Tattoo Studio, and I am extremely happy with the result. The detailing, shading, and overall composition exceeded my expectations. Saiyam was patient throughout the long session and paid close attention to every small detail. The studio maintained excellent hygiene standards and made the entire experience comfortable. The artwork flows perfectly with my arm anatomy and looks even better than I had imagined. If you’re looking for high-quality custom tattoo work, I highly recommend Saiyam and the team at Sam Tattoo Studio. Truly professional artists who are passionate about their craft. Thank you for an amazing tattoo experience!
